features.title: Comfort that lasts
features.text: Upholstered in soft, 100% polyester velvet fabric, this sofa feels as good as it looks, adding a cosy and elegant touch to your living space.

features.title: Sink-In Back Comfort with Elastic Bands
features.text: Elastic bands in the back frame ensure proper lumbar support, creating a snug, sink-in experience every time you sit.

features.title: Nature’s finest, built to endure
features.text: Made using pinewood and MDF, this sofa is built to withstand everyday use while maintaining its polished look and moisture resistant structure.

features.title: Gentle bounce, perfect support
features.text: Built with an S spring suspension system in the base frame, this sofa offers just the right balance of bounce and support—cradling you in comfort while keeping you feeling light and relaxed.

features.title: A secret spot for everything you need
features.text: Keep your essentials within reach with deep storage built into the armrest. Perfect for stashing remotes, books, or gadgets, it keeps your space clutter-free while adding convenience to your comfort.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
